case_title.quote: BHAIKON @ BAKUL BORAH v. STATE OF ASSAM

number_of_accused.reason: One accused was tried; an unnamed companion is mentioned but not prosecuted.

accused_gender.quote: the accused is a young man of 33 years of age

accused_age.quote: young man of 33 years of age

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation is expressly stated; he only has a farm house and a labourer.

victim_gender.quote: Rupamoni Dutta (the deceased), aged about 22 years

accused_victim_relationship.quote: he heard a loud laughter at the farm house of the appellant-accused
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The judgment never says they were strangers; both were from the same locality and the relationship is not described.

offence_category.quote: the appellant along with another person committed rape and, thereafter, murdered the deceased
offence_category.reason: Both rape and murder were charged and upheld; only murder is listed.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 302 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860

weapon.quote: since both them were having 'Khukri' in their hands
weapon.reason: Weapons are mentioned: khukri, a seized dao, and a sharp cutting weapon causing the injuries.

evidence_type.quote: the evidence of PWs 1, 2 and 9 as well as the statement of co-villagers
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and seized-item evidence all appear.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Heinous rape and murder; body thrown in bushes and shrubs
aggravating_circumstances.quote: considering the heinous crime of committing rape and murder and throwing the dead body in a place surrounded by bushes and shrubs
aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment records aggravating features, so 'None noted' is wrong.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Young age of 33; not rarest of rare
mitigating_circumstances.quote: the accused is a young man of 33 years of age and also finding that the case does not come under the purview of the "rarest of rare" category
mitigating_circumstances.reason: High Court's mitigating considerations are recorded.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced him to death for the offence punishable under Section 302 of IPC and rigorous imprisonment (RI) for life for the offence punishable under Section 376

high_court_outcome.quote: altering the sentence of death to imprisonment for life ... imprisonment for 7 years

offence_finally_established.quote: upholding the conviction under both the counts

imprisonment_type.quote: altering the sentence of death to imprisonment for life

imprisonment_years.reason: Life term, so no fixed years for murder; 7 years for rape is separate.

fine_rs.quote: along with a fine of Rs.1,000/-, in default, to further undergo imprisonment for 1 (one) month
fine_rs.reason: High Court imposed a fine of Rs.1,000 under s.302.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the claim that items found with the accused were linked to the crime; they were only seized and sent to FSL.
neutral_facts.quote: The seized underwears of both the appellant and the deceased were sent to FSL for examination.
neutral_facts.reason: Core facts are right, but the link between seized items and the crime is not established in the judgment.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment for murder and 7 years for rape (death sentence by trial court reduced)
offence_severity.quote: altering the sentence of death to imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: Gives the trial court's sentence, not the final one.

attempt_completion.quote: the girl died on the spot

physical_harm.quote: the person died of asphyxia as result of throttling

motive.reason: No motive stated beyond the rape.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: there is no reason to disbelieve the version of PW-1 and the corroborative evidence of PW-2

witness_credibility.quote: the trial Court found him trustworthy that he had nothing to falsely implicate his master

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused returned home, later came to the spot and enquired; he and his companion dragged the body to the bushes

legal_representation.quote: Pandit Parmanand Katara, Abhishek Sharma, C.K. Sucharita, Kusum Lata Sharma for the Appellant

investigation_status.quote: the police submitted charge-sheet against the appellant-accused

prosecution_argument.quote: the evidence of PW-1, who witnessed the occurrence is reliable and is corroborated by PW-2
prosecution_argument.reason: Matches, with the State's remission point omitted.

defence_argument.quote: the evidence of PW-1 is not reliable

legal_principle_applied.quote: life imprisonment means imprisonment for whole of life subject to the remission power

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Life Convict @ Khoka Prasanta Sen vs. B.K. Srivastava & Ors. (2013) 3 SCC 425

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Trial court gave death for the heinous crime and body disposal; High Court commuted it citing age 33 and not rarest of rare
sentencing_rationale.quote: the trial Court has awarded the sentence of death, however, the High Court, taking note of the fact that the accused is a young man of 33 years
sentencing_rationale.reason: Attributes the heinousness and body disposal to the final sentence; they were the trial court's grounds.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: young man of 33 years of age and ... does not come under the purview of the "rarest of rare"

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: heinous crime of committing rape and murder and throwing the dead body in a place surrounded by bushes and shrubs
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Matches, though these were the trial court's grounds.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other order beyond the fine and default term.
